title: It's not clear in advance whether a hold's small barrow/cairn side-dungeon (the Forebarrow, the Weeping Cairn, Longacre Chapel, the Pilgrims' Shrine) ends in a lootable 'search the alcove' or a narrative-only rite with no item, so there's no way to know if you've 'finished' one until after you've already committed the turns to clear it.
